تزجون (form I)
# تَزُجُّونَ (tazujjūna) /ta.zud͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of زَجَّ (zajja)
# تُزَجُّونَ (tuzajjūna) /tu.zad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of زَجَّ (zajja)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
